description: Recent SEC EDGAR filings of a company (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and more), found by ticker, CIK or name. A name that matches several filers returns candidates with HTTP 400, not charged. Each filing gives the form, filing and report dates, description, index page and primary document. Source: SEC EDGAR, public domain. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

forms.description: Comma-separated form types, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K. Default: all
